provenance.why: v11 searched 96 blocks from where it stood and the spawn forest was gone; the gather-wood command then failed three honest times in one battery. A gatherer that wants wood must go where wood is: four 36-block walks, searching after each, before it admits there is no tree. The walk direction is fixed (+36,+36) because the sandbox offers no randomness; four walks covers new ground each time from wherever the last one ended.

title: walk to the forest, chop a tree, leave what it gives at the depot
